records.title: Ahab and Micaiah
records.posterAlt: Micaiah addresses two seated kings at a city gate. An imagined scene.
records.description: Micaiah lowers his hand while Ahab and Jehoshaphat listen. This selects the council in 1 Kings 22:9-18, not the later battle.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size two-second sample and 1fps sheet preserve Ahab’s mature brown face, gray-streaked curls and beard, burgundy mantle and circlet. Jehoshaphat stays distinct in teal. Micaiah retains the v2 graying face and coarse mantle rather than being assigned Elijah’s identity. Visible hands, staff, seated bodies and crowd are coherent in samples.

records.title: Elijah Taken Up
records.posterAlt: Elisha watches a distant figure rise within a luminous whirlwind. An imagined scene.
records.description: Elisha watches the whirlwind beside the Jordan while holding a mantle. This selects Elijah’s departure in 2 Kings 2:11-13.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet preserve Elisha’s bald crown, dark side curls, brown complexion, build, linen and mantle. Elijah remains tiny and distant; facial identity is not verifiable at that scale. The clouds, river, hands and cloth remain coherent in inspected frames. No new deity or burning person appears.

records.title: Elisha and Moab
records.posterAlt: Elisha stands beside trenches where men gather water. An imagined scene.
records.description: Water fills the camp’s trenches as Elisha gestures and men gather it. This selects the provision of water in 2 Kings 3:16-20.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet preserve Elisha’s angular brown face, bald crown, dark side curls, graying beard and rough mantle. Men kneel or approach the existing trenches with coherent hands and limbs in samples. Dawn light and the imagined camp remain compatible; the scene does not depict the later sacrifice or battle.

records.title: The Widow's Oil and the Shunammite's Son
records.posterAlt: A widow pours oil into a jar while her two sons help. An imagined scene.
records.description: The widow pours oil while her sons move the jars, with the door shut. This selects 2 Kings 4:3-6, not the separate Shunammite family.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size two- and four-second samples and 1fps sheet retain the mother’s brown face, braids, teal covering and both boys’ distinct faces, tight curls and proportions. Door stays closed; no adult observer is introduced. Oil flows from the pitcher rim into the jar, and visible hands, handles and bodies remain coherent in samples.

records.title: Naaman Healed
records.posterAlt: Naaman looks at his hands while standing in the Jordan. An imagined scene.
records.description: Naaman lowers his hands after washing while servants wait on the bank. This selects his healed moment in 2 Kings 5:14.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain Naaman’s brown face, natural curls, full beard, sturdy build and wet linen. Servants remain distinct and no attendant is labeled Elisha. Hands, river, reeds and the distant horse remain coherent in inspected samples.

records.title: Elisha and the Arameans
records.posterAlt: A man reaches toward a floating axe head as Elisha points. An imagined scene.
records.description: A man reaches toward the borrowed iron axe head floating in the river. This selects 2 Kings 6:5-7 rather than the later Aramean siege.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain Elisha’s brown angular face, bald crown, side curls, beard and mantle, comparable with the Moab scene. The younger man stays distinct. The iron head remains detached from the handle and floating; hands, pointing finger, limbs and water remain coherent in samples.

records.title: Jehu's Revolt
records.posterAlt: A messenger pours oil onto Jehu’s head in a closed room. An imagined scene.
records.description: The messenger anoints seated Jehu behind a shut door. This selects 2 Kings 9:2-6, not the later revolt or violence.

records.title: Athaliah and Joash
records.posterAlt: Jehoiada settles a circlet on young Joash’s head. An imagined scene.
records.description: Jehoiada crowns seven-year-old Joash of Judah while witnesses watch. This selects 2 Kings 11:12,21, not Athaliah’s death or later repairs.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet preserve child Joash’s brown face, soft curls and child proportions, plus Jehoiada’s gray beard, older face and linen headdress. The other priest keeps the scroll. Hands, circlet, bodies and witnesses remain coherent in inspected samples. This child is distinct from Jehoash of Israel in the later scene.

records.title: Elisha's Death and Israel's Victories
records.posterAlt: Elderly Elisha guides a king holding a bow toward a window. An imagined scene.
records.description: Elderly Elisha rests his hands on Jehoash of Israel’s hands before the arrow is shot. This selects the counsel in 2 Kings 13:14-17.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain the elderly Elisha’s brown face, bald crown, gray side curls and long gray beard; substantial aging follows intervening reigns without assigning an exact age. Adult Jehoash of Israel remains distinct from child Joash of Judah. Visible overlapping hands, bow, arrow and limbs are coherent in samples; the arrow is held rather than released.

records.title: The Fall of Samaria
records.posterAlt: Families carry belongings out through Samaria’s gate. An imagined scene.
records.description: Families walk slowly out through Samaria’s gate after its capture. This selects displacement in 2 Kings 17:5-6, not a complete siege reconstruction.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC
records.visualReview: Full-size sample and 1fps sheet retain distinct brown faces, natural curls, ages, joined hands, bundles, staff and plain clothing. The family is anonymous, not assigned to earlier patriarchs or later Jerusalem exiles. Feet, limbs, bundles and distant stationary soldiers remain coherent in inspected samples.
